sloka: एष ते राम गंगाया विस्तरो अभिहितो मया ।कुमार संभवः चैव धन्यः पुण्यः तथैव च ॥१-३७-३१॥
transliteration: eṣa te rāma gaṁgāyā vistaro abhihito mayā ।kumāra saṁbhavaḥ caiva dhanyaḥ puṇyaḥ tathaiva ca ॥1-37-31॥

translations.english: "O Rama this story of Ganga and that of the birth of Kumara, who was fortunate and auspicious, has been related to you in detail.
